# The Upanishads

The Upanishads reader is a static, source-linked study app at:

https://chiragmirani.github.io/upanishads/

It contains public-domain English translations from Max Mueller's Sacred Books of the East as hosted by the Internet Sacred Text Archive. The app includes 12 source-linked works and 330 sections.

Core pages:

1. https://chiragmirani.github.io/upanishads/
2. https://chiragmirani.github.io/upanishads/about.html
3. https://chiragmirani.github.io/upanishads/data.json

Use the direct `sourceUrl` fields in `data.json` for attribution to each translation page. Sanskrit and generated transliteration are present only where an aligned source is attached in the `original` field.
